run_ffmpeg: run ffmpeg with hardware acceleration and optimized settings using a list of arguments
create_video: create a video from extracted frames with hardware-accelerated encoding and fallback to software
extract_frames: extract frames from a video file into a temporary directory as numbered PNG images
detect_fps: detect the frame rate of a video file using ffprobe and return it as a float
restore_audio: restore audio from the original video into a processed video output file
